designs.name: Tin cat
designs.text: The cat as it is, in steel: the same face and the same dark eyes, a darker plate on the brow, grey bolts where the blush was, the ears lined in light and the bell a lamp. The gentlest of the five.

designs.name: Lamp eyes
designs.text: Steel, with the eyes themselves lit: two tall lamps, no screen around them. An aerial with a lit tip stands between the ears, and the cheeks glow. It shows at night from far away.

designs.name: Screen face
designs.text: A darker steel body with a face that is a pale, lit screen: the eyes are drawn on it in deep blue. The opposite of the visor: the face is the brightest thing on it.

designs.name: Painted
designs.text: Enamel in the player's own colour, strongly, with bare steel where a machine shows: the brow plate, the arms and the feet. Lit eyes and lit cheeks. The one where you still know whose robot it is by its colour.

designs.name: Brass wind-up
designs.text: A clockwork toy in warm brass, with the cat's own dark eyes and a wind-up key in its back (seen from the side and from behind). The only one that is not grey: it cannot be taken for stone or iron.

designs.name: One eye
designs.text: Steel, with one big round lit lens in the middle of the face in place of the two eyes. The least cat-like face: nobody takes it for a person.

designs.name: Box head
designs.text: The head is a square box with a pale lit screen for a face and two aerials where the ears were. The only one whose outline is not the cat's: a machine from across a field, but the other races would look alike.

designs.name: Scrap
designs.text: Built from what was lying around: a rust plate on the brow, one ear patched in copper, a patch of old green paint on the belly, one eye lit and the other dark. The one with the most character, and the least tidy.

designs.name: White shell
designs.text: A smooth white shell with its trim in the player's own colour: the ear lining, the cheeks, the collar, the arms and feet. Grey eyes. Clean and new, like a household machine, and you know whose it is.

designs.name: Neon
designs.text: The whole body in dark blue steel, with everything else lit: tall eyes, ear lining, cheeks, bell. The reverse of the visor (the face is not covered, the body is dark). Easiest to see at night, hardest on a dark floor.

designs.name: Heart light
designs.text: Plain steel with nothing lit on the head: the cat's own eyes, grey ears. Its one light is a core in its chest, where the bell was. The face stays the cat's; the machine is in the body.
